title: Change-Order Size Rates
content:
# Change-Order Size Rates

Window Replacement Contracts. The change-order fee is multiplied by a change size share set by the openings priced across all customer lines of the most recent customer change order: at least 10 openings (the many-openings count) takes the many-openings share of 1.25; fewer than 3 openings (the few-openings count) takes the few-openings share of 0.75; any other change order takes a share of one.

The openings priced are added up line by line over the change order's customer lines, so an opening priced on two lines counts twice; an oversize surcharge line is not counted. The share multiplies the fee before it is rounded to the cent.

| Openings priced across the change order's customer lines | Size share |
|---|---|
| 1 or 2 | 0.75 |
| 3 to 9 | 1 |
| 10 or more | 1.25 |

## Hypothetical counts

- Triple-pane on 4 openings and grilles on the same 4 openings: 8 openings priced, share 1.
- Hardware finish on 2 openings: share 0.75.
- Laminated glass on 6 openings and tempered glass on 4 openings: 10 openings priced, share 1.25.
